description.zh:
銀行利息：請依照下方英文原題的輸入、輸出規格完成程式。

輸入以 0 結束的題目不要把結尾的 0 納入統計；需要小數結果時使用 double。
description.en:
An initial integer deposit grows by P percent each year, discarding fractional cents. Print the number of years needed to reach at least Y.

C++ note: For zero-terminated input, do not include the terminating zero. Use double when the result may be fractional.
